messages.content: 尋找從紐約到波士頓的最快路線。

function.name: prime_numbers_in_range
function.description: Find all the prime numbers within a certain numeric range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start.description: The start of the numeric range.

end.description: The end of the numeric range.

return_format.description: The format in which the prime numbers should be returned.
